title: Prayag SKU Deep Dive
description: A 45-slide operating guide to every tab, calculation, decision, and alert FY2026–27 management edition

title: What SKU Deep Dive enables
description: - Move from category performance to item-code action - Separate value, volume, price, breadth, timing, and distribution effects - Diagnose gaps at company, territory, distributor, retailer, and project levels - Convert exceptions into assortment, stock, pricing, coverage, and recovery decisions

title: The nine operating tabs
description: - Overview: segment scale, breadth, and gap value - Review and Push: management gaps and distributor assortment recommendations - Trends, Discounts, and Timing: movement through time, realised pricing, and seasonality - Movement, Vol Decline, and Price Shrinkers: item-level deterioration signals

title: The data architecture behind SKU Deep Dive
description: - Primary evidence: current-version invoice rows from sale_line - Secondary evidence: order-booking registers and retailer-level SKU sources - Product identity: item code, segment, category registry, and catalogue authority - Pricing authority: effective MRP history and the active completed MRP generation - Attribution: people, state, distributor, retailer, customer, and project mappings

title: FY and period selection
description: - FY selects the reporting year and determines the like-period prior FY - YTD, quarter, full year, month, last 7 days, today, and custom define the period - Fiscal monthFrom and monthTo are passed to every supported calculation - Like-for-like comparisons use the same fiscal months in both years - Open months may remain provisional until the source lock date

title: Level and entity scope
description: - Levels: Distributor, Direct Dealer, Project / Govt, and Retailer - Scope can be company-wide or narrowed to a state head and selected entity - State and distributor filters apply only where the tab supports those dimensions - Retailer-level secondary data rejects unsupported entity filters rather than guessing - Project-channel activity is separated from ordinary territory breadth

title: How to read data availability
description: - Zero means measured evidence produced a zero result - Unavailable means the required source or dimension was not present - Unsupported means the chosen level or filter cannot be calculated correctly - Degraded banners identify source quota, roster, or member-resolution problems - A complete prior build is required before a snapshot may be used as fallback

title: The core SKU measures
description: - Net: booked-order or invoiced value on the tab’s declared source basis - Quantity: pieces for ordinary items; litres where the tank model applies - Bought: ever-sold codes present in the selected period - Unbought: ever-sold codes absent in the selected period - Breadth %: bought codes divided by the declared ever-sold denominator

title: Overview — purpose
description: - Summarise SKU activity by segment for the selected period and level - Show booked-order net, quantity, active codes, missing codes, and breadth - Identify where lost assortment carries material historical value - Open a segment drill-down for code-level investigation - Start every SKU review with scale before examining exceptions

title: Overview — headline cards
description: - Total booked order net: selected-period Sub Total across eligible SKU rows - Codes bought: distinct active item codes in the selected period - Segments: distinct mapped segments represented in the result - Quantity: total pieces where aggregation is valid - Unmapped codes: value and share that cannot be assigned to a segment

title: Overview — segment table
description: - Segment identifies the source-aligned product grouping - Booked order net and share show contribution to the selected result - Bought and Unbought divide the ever-sold code universe - Gap codes’ net estimates the historical value attached to absent codes - Breadth % shows assortment participation, not market share

title: Overview — gap codes’ net
description: - Start with codes sold historically but absent from selected-period orders - Use realised sales for the same fiscal months across loaded FYs - Sum eligible historical net without extrapolating a full-year forecast - Rank larger recoverable value ahead of low-value assortment noise - Treat it as an opportunity indicator, not a guaranteed order value

title: Overview — breadth calculation
description: - Numerator: distinct ever-sold codes bought in the selected period - Denominator: codes ever sold on the declared company-wide or level basis - Breadth = Bought divided by Bought plus Unbought - Entity filters may narrow current activity while the denominator remains company-wide - Read filtered breadth only with the on-screen denominator warning

title: Overview — segment drill-down
description: - Opens the selected segment from an Overview, Review, or Push row - Shows net, quantity, breadth, bought codes, ever-sold codes, and catalogue count - Lists item-code evidence for direct action and reconciliation - Large results are limited to the top 500 rows and display a truncation notice - Use exports when the operating decision needs the complete code list

title: Overview — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: protect segments with high value and healthy breadth - Decision: recover high gap-value segments with weak current breadth - Decision: investigate material unmapped value before acting commercially - Alert: breadth drops beyond tolerance in a material segment - Alert: unmapped net or code count rises above the approved threshold

title: Review — purpose
description: - Create a company-wide management list of SKU gaps - Combine current activity, historical value, breadth, and availability context - Prioritise missing or weakening codes that matter commercially - Exclude normal project-channel activity from territory breadth logic - Move from a segment exception into the code-level drill

title: Review — calculation basis
description: - Evaluate codes against current-period activity and historical evidence - Preserve the selected FY and fiscal-month range - Use raw SKU evidence where retailer-level questions require it - Keep catalogue existence separate from historical sales presence - Do not substitute MRP, dashboard totals, or product aggregates for raw transactions

title: Review — prioritisation logic
description: - Material historical net increases the priority of an absent code - Breadth loss distinguishes distribution weakness from isolated timing - Current catalogue status separates actionable products from retired lines - Segment and level context prevent unlike codes from being compared casually - Data-quality exceptions remain visible instead of entering a commercial rank

title: Review — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: select codes for recovery, availability checks, or field validation - Decision: separate discontinued, project-only, and truly missed items - Decision: assign high-value gaps to a named territory owner - Alert: historically material code disappears from active sales - Alert: reviewed exception remains unresolved across consecutive closed periods

title: Push — purpose
description: - Recommend codes a distributor or direct dealer should consider adding - Compare the selected entity with peers active in the same segment - Convert peer assortment evidence into a practical sales-call list - Preserve the requested period and selected distributor scope - Show Push only for levels where a defensible peer comparison exists

title: Push — peer cohort construction
description: - Start with distributors active in the selected segment - Prefer same-state peers when the cohort has sufficient evidence - Require at least three peers before using a cohort signal - Use a national fallback when the state cohort is too small - Keep the selected distributor out of its own peer benchmark

title: Push — recommendation and verdict
description: - Candidate code is absent for the selected distributor in the period - Peer adoption and segment activity provide the comparison evidence - Historical value and breadth context support prioritisation - The output is a recommendation, not proof of local demand - Management must check availability, territory fit, and distributor capacity

title: Push — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: create a distributor-specific assortment expansion plan - Decision: sequence recommended codes by peer evidence and value - Decision: test a focused range before broad stocking - Alert: high-peer-adoption code remains absent for a material distributor - Alert: Push recommendation changes because cohort evidence falls below minimum

title: Trends — purpose
description: - Show how item value, quantity, and breadth move through time - Keep fiscal months in chronological rather than alphabetical order - Separate one-month timing noise from persistent direction - Compare like periods on a consistent SKU and entity basis - Use trend shape before assigning a cause

title: Trends — calculation
description: - Aggregate eligible SKU rows by fiscal month and selected dimension - Calculate value and quantity on the tab’s declared source basis - Count active codes or entities for breadth context - Compare current and prior FY using matching fiscal months - Preserve missing periods as missing evidence rather than manufactured zeros

title: Trends — seasonality and interpretation
description: - Compare the observed month pattern with the approved seasonal curve - Use segment-specific curves where CPVC, C P, or Sanitaryware behave differently - Distinguish a normal seasonal low from structural loss - Treat open-month movement as provisional until closure - Investigate changes that persist after seasonal context is applied

title: Trends — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: time stocking, campaigns, and field focus around demand windows - Decision: protect items showing sustained acceleration - Decision: investigate persistent value, quantity, or breadth deterioration - Alert: three-period decline after seasonality adjustment - Alert: trend reverses materially after a previously stable run

title: Discounts — purpose
description: - Identify realised pricing and discount patterns by item and entity - Compare invoice realisation with effective authoritative MRP where available - Expose missing or ambiguous MRP coverage rather than inventing a rate - Separate price behaviour from volume and assortment movement - Support commercial discipline without treating every variance as leakage

title: Discounts — calculation and MRP authority
description: - Realised unit price = invoice net divided by comparable quantity - Effective MRP is selected for the matching item code and period - Closed periods use MRP history; current periods use the active completed generation - Ambiguous code-to-segment matches are rejected - Discount analysis is unavailable when authoritative MRP coverage is absent

title: Discounts — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: investigate discount leakage on material items - Decision: distinguish approved trade support from unexplained realisation loss - Decision: review territory, distributor, and salesperson concentration - Alert: realised discount moves outside the approved corridor - Alert: sold item has no effective authoritative MRP

title: Timing — purpose
description: - Reveal when products sell within the FY and whether timing is shifting - Compare actual invoice months with the approved seasonal pattern - Show whether apparent weakness reflects lateness or lost demand - Preserve segment differences in seasonal behaviour - Support stock and campaign timing decisions

title: Timing — calculation
description: - Group eligible invoice value and quantity by fiscal month - Express each month as a share of the selected FY evidence - Compare the observed cumulative curve with the expected seasonal curve - Use like-for-like closed months when comparing years - Avoid extrapolating incomplete open months as final demand

title: Timing — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: stock before proven demand windows - Decision: shift campaign and field activity to periods with recoverable opportunity - Decision: avoid overreacting to a normal seasonal trough - Alert: material sales arrive later than the historical timing pattern - Alert: cumulative progress falls behind the approved curve for consecutive closures

title: Movement — purpose
description: - Classify items by acceleration, stability, slowdown, or inactivity - Combine current-versus-prior movement with value and breadth context - Rank material changes above low-value noise - Distinguish a broad distribution change from one-customer volatility - Create a repeatable item review queue

title: Movement — classification logic
description: - Compare selected-period current value with the matching prior-year period - Add quantity and breadth direction where the evidence supports them - Acceleration requires positive comparable movement - Slowdown or inactivity requires a measured decline or absence - Unavailable comparison evidence remains unclassified

title: Movement — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: protect accelerating items with supply and coverage support - Decision: recover high-value slowing items before they become inactive - Decision: deprioritise immaterial volatility - Alert: high-value SKU moves from stable to declining - Alert: an accelerating item loses breadth despite value growth

title: Vol Decline — purpose
description: - Find items losing physical demand even when price changes mask the fall - Compare current and prior like-period quantity on a consistent basis - Require a material prior-period value floor before qualifying an item - Keep territory and project scope explicit - Rank the largest comparable volume deterioration

title: Vol Decline — formula and units
description: - Quantity growth % = current quantity divided by prior quantity minus one - Value growth % = current net divided by prior net minus one - Ordinary products use pieces; tank products use litre logic - Both periods require positive comparable quantity and value evidence - Primary floor defaults to ₹50,000 prior-period net for materiality

title: Vol Decline — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: test stock availability, substitution, coverage, and price resistance - Decision: separate physical demand loss from value protected by inflation - Decision: prioritise material codes with broad customer impact - Alert: quantity falls beyond tolerance while realised price is flat or rising - Alert: litre decline persists across multiple closed periods

title: Price Shrinkers — purpose
description: - Detect items whose economic growth is negative after MRP movement - Focus on codes where quantity grew but real value still deteriorated - Use authoritative period MRP to separate list-price change from real growth - Reject missing or ambiguous MRP mappings - Rank the most negative real-growth results first

title: Price Shrinkers — formulas and qualification
description: - Quantity growth % = current quantity divided by prior quantity minus one - Value growth % = current net divided by prior net minus one - MRP increase % = current MRP divided by prior-period MRP minus one - Real growth % = value growth % minus MRP increase % - Qualify only when quantity growth is positive and real growth is negative

title: Price Shrinkers — decisions and alerts
description: - Decision: investigate discounting, mix change, data error, or competitive pressure - Decision: compare realised price movement with approved commercial support - Decision: protect volume without accepting unexplained value erosion - Alert: real growth remains negative above the material-value floor - Alert: realised price falls while authoritative MRP rises

title: Exports, reconciliation, and data controls
description: - Excel exports use the same route calculations and selected query parameters - Basis sheets preserve FY, period, level, scope, filters, and caveats - General exports state that breadth denominators may remain company-wide - Quantities must not be summed casually across pieces and litres - Data Health, wipe canaries, source locks, and mapping checks gate release

title: A practical SKU alert portfolio
description: - Availability: material code disappears or remains absent despite peer adoption - Breadth: active retailer or distributor coverage falls beyond tolerance - Volume: like-period pieces or litres decline beyond the approved threshold - Price: realised value or real growth deteriorates without an approved reason - Data: raw month, MRP, category, state, or identity evidence is missing

title: The Prayag SKU operating rhythm
description: - Daily: review material alerts, source failures, and sudden availability gaps - Weekly: run Review, Push, distributor assortment, and recovery actions - Monthly: close the period, verify Data Health, and reconcile exports - Quarterly: reset thresholds, peer cohorts, seasonal assumptions, and category priorities - Success measure: broader productive assortment, protected realisation, and faster named action
